title: Rajbadhu
desc: Ranjan loves Neela but introduces Pranati as his wife to his father. However, he accepts Pranati as his wife after seeing Neela with another man in a compromising position.

title: Abhimanyu
desc: Raj Sinha, a policeman, kills gangster Durjo Rai's son in an encounter. He soon asks Abhimanyu, a suspended colleague, to protect the last two members of his family from Rai.

title: Nagin Kanya
desc: Jeevan and Puja's lives change forever when they become victims of a bad curse. While Jeevan and his friend lose their lives, Puja takes the form of a snake.

title: Boumar Banabash
desc: A royal couple faces divine punishment as the wife endures exile while the prince grapples with a mysterious curse that threatens both love and destiny.

title: Ajker Santan
desc: Chandranath, a factory worker, dies trying to fund his daughter Rani's wedding. After his death, his biological children mistreat his family, while his adopted son Aninda shows true loyalty.
